@graph.description: Hear from Emily Kaufman, the Travel Mom, on the importance of a travel insurance plan when taking a cruise. Visit our website to learn more now.

@graph.name: Is Cruise Insurance Worth It?
@graph.description: With a cruise you are often coordinating a lot of arrangements. Travel to the port city, hotel stays before your cruise and of course, the cruise itself. One delay could impact the whole trip and that’s where Travel Guard can help!
@graph.transcript:
[EMILY KAUFMAN]
I’m Emily Kaufman, The Travel Mom.
[TOMMY DIDARIO]
Hi, I’m Tommy Didario.
[EMILY]
We sure do love a cruise vacation!
[TOMMY]
But we never get on board without a travel insurance plan.
[EMILY]
That’s right, and it’s important to understand that your medical insurance may not cover you when you’re sailing abroad or in international waters.
[TOMMY]
If you enjoy adventurous shore excursions like water skiing or zip lining, you’re going to want to make sure you’re protected on those as well!
[EMILY]
Travel Guard has several different plan options, including their Adventure Sports Bundle and international coverage to help give you peace of mind as you set sail on a cruise vacation.
[TOMMY]
With a cruise you are often coordinating a lot of arrangements. Travel to the port city, hotel stays before your cruise and of course, the cruise itself. One delay could impact the whole trip and that’s where Travel Guard can help!
[EMILY]
There is a Travel Inconvenience Benefit, which is a one-time payment for certain inconveniences you encounter on your trip.
[TOMMY]
We’ve had the opportunity to sail on several cruises together and they sure were fun!
[EMILY]
Whether you are setting sail on the sea or embarking on a river cruise there are plans available on TravelGuard.com or you can give them a call at 1-800-208-0745.
[EMILY]
Cruises really do offer something for everyone, families, a romantic escape, a girls getaway or even a solo trip.
[TOMMY]
When you set sail, you can go with confidence that Travel Guard has got you covered…
[TOMMY]
…I’m Tommy Didario.
[EMILY]
and I’m Emily Kaufman, The Travel Mom wishing you a Bon Voyage!
